summary: OpenAI announces that Codex can now automatically perform security reviews of GitHub pull requests, posting findings inline as part of a broader initiative to apply its models to code security.

mechanisms.reason: Codex now autonomously reviews every pull request and posts findings, automating a task previously done by human reviewers.
mechanisms.quote: Codex can now perform a security review of every GitHub pull request, leaving findings inline.

practices.reason: Codex gains a new automated security-review capability integrated into the PR workflow, which a team could evaluate for its own repos.
practices.quote: Codex can now perform a security review of every GitHub pull request, leaving findings inline.

practices.reason: Inline PR findings change how a security review step could be inserted into an existing GitHub workflow, though no specifics on setup are given.
